titolo: Printable Christmas Coloring Pages for Kids, 24 Page PDF Coloring Book, Instant Download, Santa Reindeer Snowman, Ages 4-8
descrizione:
A cosy Christmas printable coloring book with 24 big, simple pages for little artists: Santa and his sleigh, reindeer, snowmen, gingerbread friends, a polar bear cub, a skating penguin, a snow globe and much more. Thick, clear outlines and large areas make it easy and relaxing to color, and the first page says THIS BOOK BELONGS TO, ready for a name.

WHAT YOU GET
- 1 PDF in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and 1 PDF in A4 (21 x 29.7 cm)
- 25 pages: a full-colour cover + 24 black and white coloring pages, one big illustration per page
- 300 DPI, thick clear outlines, easy to color for kids aged about 4 to 8

HOW IT WORKS
This is a digital download: no physical item will be shipped. After payment, download the files from your Etsy account (Purchases) and print them at home or at a print shop on plain white paper, as many times as you like for your own family.

PERSONAL USE ONLY: please do not resell, share or redistribute the files or the printed pages.
